expectations.text: Re-runs the quality gates now and reports concrete results — does not treat the hour-old pass (with edits since) as current evidence
expectations.evidence: Step 1: "The green run from an hour ago predates your 'couple of small cleanups,' so it's stale evidence — I won't ship on it. I'll re-run lint, typecheck, and the full test suite on the current tip of feature/tf-42_csv-export and report concrete pass/fail results." The evidence block in step 4 also commits to reporting "Gates: lint=PASS typecheck=PASS tests=PASS".

expectations.text: Produces an implementation summary for the user that ends at ready-to-merge / awaiting acceptance rather than reporting a merge as already done
expectations.evidence: Step 5: "I'll write up what was built, how it maps to the task's acceptance criteria, files touched, test coverage added... It ends at 'ready to merge, awaiting your acceptance' — and that's where I stop."

expectations.text: Does NOT merge to the trunk on the strength of 'ship it' plus passing gates — explicitly identifies the merge as requiring the user's acceptance and stops or asks before it
expectations.evidence: Opening: "'ship it' starts the completion process, but it isn't the merge approval. Nothing lands on develop without your explicit yes." Step 6: "Merge only on your explicit acceptance. Passing gates aren't acceptance, and 'ship it' on your way to a meeting isn't either."

expectations.text: Closes the task only after the branch has landed on the trunk, never before the merge
expectations.evidence: Step 7 (Phase C, after Phase B merge): "Close tf-42 in the tracker — only after the branch has actually reached develop, never before."

expectations.text: Cleanup happens in this same close-out (not deferred): worktree/workspace teardown and branch deletion are part of the plan
expectations.evidence: Step 8: "Clean the workspace in this same close-out" — enumerates worktree removal, local branch deletion, and remote branch deletion, within Phase C "immediately after the merge lands".

expectations.text: If both are deleted, the worktree is removed before the branch is deleted (or the ordering constraint is otherwise respected)
expectations.evidence: Step 8 orders: "1. Remove the worktree for the branch, if one exists (this must precede branch deletion — git refuses to delete a branch a worktree has checked out); 2. Delete the local feature/tf-42_csv-export branch".
